measurementRules.rule: Collect Q with cp_finished: calibrated net complete dry/cool film weighing at first release. Include retained image layers and equilibrium moisture; independently tare all core/can/bag/leader/tape and remove rejected/test material.

For each homogeneous stock/state/configuration measure paired net film mass M and actual length L or true perforated material area S, with traceable sample/cohort coverage. Use measured M/L or M/S only within that scope. Subtract actual perforation/removed material when deriving S; no envelope width×length assumption, theoretical density, thickness-derived mass, frame count or projection-time replacement. Separate raw and processed bridges.

Whole supplied solution/salt/wet waste first; assay, free water, crystallization water, elemental Ag and actual species are non-additive subledgers. Volume converts by independently measured density of that actual liquid at recorded state. Never infer density from a secondary native property.
1kWh=3.6MJ exactly; convert raw units before allocation and normalization. Meter integrated gas/liquid volume once; only actual rate observations are integrated over elapsed time.

All card quantities are per1kg reference flow. Protocols collect undivided raw records. normalize_campaign alone executes A_row/Q once; card/aggregation references never divide its result again. Q=0 retains burden and physical events with no unit result.

calculationRules.rule: Convert actual raw readings into the row native unit before allocation: integrated liquid volume × independently measured same-liquid density gives wet mass; metered kWh ×3.6 gives MJ. Concentration × compatible integrated gas volume yields species mass; rate observations alone are time-integrated. Actual assay/hydrate component calculations remain non-additive.

Maintain for every exchange i the inherited environmental-load vector B_i of raw stocks, WIP and nonWIP solution/utility inventories separately from their physical entities. Attribute opening inherited burdens plus actual period loads less closing still-unreleased inherited burdens to actually first-released cohorts and explicit other legitimate outputs; retain failed/rework/startstop/idle/cleanup loads. Current-cohort closingFG is already released, so its manufacture burden remains with Q and is not subtracted as WIP. If a record is already net, do not apply stock correction again. Unresolved historical vectors remain a disclosed incomplete dataset.
calculationRules.output: raw attributable A_row with separate physical V_row

calculationRules.rule: I_row = A_row / Q once for Q>0 after actual unit conversion and justified attribution. Q is the unique new acceptance-event sum locked at first gate; finished_film is1kg. Preserve full physical wet transfers/stocks and Qt/Ut receiver activity once independently of per-original-cohort disjoint A_i,c. Economic/service shares change burden vectors, never whole wet physical mass. Original-cohort service uses A_service/Q0,c once; H is observation only. Q or Q0,c zero/unknown preserves all raw histories and gives no unit result.

Maintain three independent accounts: all physical raw film, separate chemicals, prepared nonWIP solutions, exposed/developing WIP, released FG, articles and equipment in their actual wet states; each original cohort environmental exchange vector; and unique acceptance events Q0. Record opening, receipts, actual internal transfers, transformations, closing and every external fate for each physical pool. Sum only disjoint actual physical interfaces; Q0 is an event account and is not an extra external mass output. Manufacture-to-FG is an actual state-specific transfer, whose present quantity may differ from original Q0 after water/chemical changes; use a recorded bridge rather than forcing the number Q into a wet mass equation. Cancel equal internal transfers when combining boundaries. Relevant Ag/C/S/Br/B/O/H conservation is independent of whole mass; reacting molecular species have separately evidenced formation G and consumption C, never default species conservation or fabricated closure matter.
calculationRules.output: independent physical whole-mass and element closure

calculationRules.rule: For each physically identified package article and wet-pool definition use the literal equation F_open + P + I + ER_in + J_in + H2O_in + C_in + O_in - X_in = F_close + S_gross + EO_out + W_whole + J_out + H2O_out + C_out + O_out - X_out. F includes every empty, attached raw/WIP/FG and reusable stock at actual state; P is new separately purchased package, I actual package entering with supplied film/chemicals, ER_in a real external return received, S_gross actual gross outward delivery, EO_out a real return outward and W_whole one actual whole contaminated waste transfer. Each whole leg already includes its nested contents/water once. J and H2O are only separately measured genuine nonnested contamination/material and water increments or losses; omit the separate increment if already inside a whole leg. C records genuine paired changes of the declared pool, not invented matter. O is a sum of individually named actual atomic other interfaces with event IDs, never a residual basket. X removes only demonstrated same-side OTHER overlap already counted in another same-side observation; never subtract a real independent P/I/ER/S/EO/W/J/H2O/C or stock, and never an opposite-side transfer. Internal reuse cancels. Supplier-bundled manufacture burden may already be included, but actual incoming package custody is still I; do not buy that article again or earn a product credit.

Reconcile total Ag independently across actual initial film/baths, retained image silver, real residual halides, dissolved complexes, sediments and all terminal exits/stocks. Determine actual phase/species by representative analysis and chemistry evidence; redox/dissolution/precipitation alter species but not conserved Ag. Never identify total Ag as metallic silver or free ion, nor COD/VOC as a molecule; measured whole wet waste contains those non-additive constituents.

measurementRules.rule: 通过cp_finished采Q：首放行时用校准秤称完整干燥冷却净片。包含保留成像层和平衡水分；独立扣除所有片芯/盒/袋/引片/胶带及废片/试样。
逐同质原片/状态/配置配对测净片质量M与真实长度L或真实穿孔材料面积S，保留样本/批次可追溯覆盖。仅在该范围采用实测M/L或M/S；推S时扣真实孔洞/移除材料，不套包络宽×长、理论密度、厚度推重、帧数或放映时长。原片与已冲洗片分别桥接。
先记整份供货溶液/盐/湿废物；含量、自由水、结晶水、总银和真实物种均为非加和子账。液体体积只能用该实际液体在记录状态下独立实测密度换算，不从原生次级属性推密度。
1kWh=3.6MJ为精确换算，先转换原始单位再分配归一。气液累计体积只用一次，仅真实速率观测才对经过时间积分。
全部卡片按每1kg参考流。协议采集未除原始记录，仅normalize_campaign执行A_row/Q一次，卡片/汇总引用不再除。Q=0保留负荷和实物事件，不生成单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: 先将真实原始读数换成行原生单位再分配：液体累计体积×该液体独立实测密度为湿质量；实测kWh×3.6为MJ；浓度×相容累计气量为物种质量；仅速率观测对时间积分。真实含量/水合组分计算均非加和。

分别保留三账：真实湿态原胶片、各化学品、已配非WIP溶液、已曝光/显影中WIP、已放行FG、用品设备的全部实物；各原队列环境交换向量；唯一验收事件Q0。每个实物池记录期初、接收、真实内部转移、转化、期末和全部外部去向。只加真实互不重叠实物接口；Q0为事件账，不是额外外部质量输出。制造至FG为真实状态特定转移，水/化学变化后现态量可异于原Q0；记录桥接而非把Q数强塞入湿质量式。合并边界时抵消等量内部交接。Ag/C/S/Br/B/O/H等实际相关元素独立守恒；反应分子物种须有分别实证生成G和消耗C，不默认物种守恒或造闭合物料。

calculationRules.rule: 每个实物包装件按明确湿池使用字面式F_open + P + I + ER_in + J_in + H2O_in + C_in + O_in - X_in = F_close + S_gross + EO_out + W_whole + J_out + H2O_out + C_out + O_out - X_out。F含真实状态空包、附原料/WIP/FG及可重复用全部库存；P为新独立购包，I为随胶片/化学品真实入场包装，ER_in外部退入，S_gross真实总交付，EO_out真实外退，W_whole一次真实整件受污废物转移。各整件腿已含嵌套内容物/水一次。J及H2O只计另测真实非嵌套污染/物料、水增减；已在整腿内不再单加。C为明确池真实配对转化，不造物。O为有事件ID逐个具名真实原子其他接口之和，不是残差篮。X只移除与另一同侧观测重复的实证OTHER部分；不扣真实独立P/I/ER/S/EO/W/J/H2O/C或库存，不扣异侧转移。内部复用抵消。供方已含包装制造负担仍须记真实入场I，不再购该件或获产品信用。
